emails.subject: Everything about setting up my site
emails.body:
Hi team,

I'm brand new and want to get the site live this week, so I've written everything down in one go, sorry for the long email.

First, the header: I want our logo on the left, the menu in the middle and a 'Join now' button on the right. The logo file we have is an SVG, is that supported? Second, the main menu: we need Home, Find a Member, Events, Blog, About and Contact, and I'd like Events and Blog to sit under a 'Community' dropdown. Third, the home page: a big search bar at the top so visitors can search members by name and city, then a row of featured members, then our latest blog posts. Fourth, the footer: three columns with our address, quick links and social icons, plus a copyright line. Fifth, the filters on the search page: city, membership level and services offered. Sixth, colours: our brand blue is #0B3D91 and we'd like rounded buttons. Seventh, the domain: we own findamember.org at GoDaddy and want the site to load there with https. Eighth, managers: two volunteers need to approve listings but should not see payments.

I know this is a lot. If you can only answer some of it now, please start with the domain and the header, because our launch announcement goes out on Monday.

Many thanks,
Henry Moore
Volunteer Coordinator
